newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal may extend bank reserve period.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal may extend bank reserve period.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal may extend its reserve period for commercial banks as it tends to be shorter than in most other European countries, but no decision should be expected soon, Bank Governor Antonio de Sousa said.
"The issue is only just starting to be studied," he told journalists.
The bank's reserve period normally runs for some seven or eight working days.
The bank was also studying possible changes to the calculation and the level of remuneration of the reserves, he said without giving details.
Another possible change would be to allow the use of non-state debt, with adequate rating and liquidity, for open market operations, de Sousa said.
